# Import inventory CSV

**Status:** accepted

Import UTF-8 CSV text with name,quantity headings through import_rows(text). Return name strings
and validated nonnegative integer quantities in input order. Reject a missing heading or invalid
quantity with ValueError before returning any records. Empty input with the headings returns an
empty list. Use Python's standard library. This effort covers the parser and its caller-visible
checks on the current Linux development target. No interface, installation or publishing work
is part of this effort.

# Field shelf

A local inventory command-line application for Whitney. Keep item names and quantities offline.
Current agreed development work targets Linux. Windows and macOS support are possible later
work; their inclusion and timing have not been decided. No public release, date, versioning
policy or compatibility promise has been agreed.
